# Original money formatter reference

Exact crates.io rusty-money 0.4.1 package used by the pinned AppFlowy Database; package checksum matches the existing Cargo.lock. Original formatter, locale, Money display and license are extracted unchanged for reproducible review. Runtime still links that existing dependency. P21 only extends the original finite separator pattern through Decimal capacity in the AppFlowy type-option wrapper; no new money engine or serialization.
